|ingredients = {{Name|Egg|1}}{{Name|Milk|1}} |sellprice = 125 |edibility = 40 }} The '''Omelet''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Omelet may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Omelet may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy |hate=Sebastian |dislike=Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Omelet is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Farmer's Lunch|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Omelet is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt021|link=Tailoring{{!}}Yellow and Green Shirt|class=inline}}.
